newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sheremetyevo handled 10.5 mln passengers in '96.
newsitem.headline: Sheremetyevo handled 10.5 mln passengers in '96.

text.p: Russia's main international airport Sheremetyevo handled about 10.5 million passengers this year after 9.7 million in 1995, a top official said on Friday.
Chief executive Sergei Sutulov told Reuters that cargo handling operations would be increased five per cent this year compared with 1995. He did not give figures.
Sheremetyevo airport worked with 70 Russian and Western airlines in 1996, he said.

Sutulov also said during this year the airport could increased its capacity to 800 passengers per hour from 150 passengers at international sectors. "We plan to modernise both passenger terminals next year," he added.
